messages:
sam: FYI folks 0m: meeting start shifted by 5m and we're swapping order7: putting roadmap Q&A first so leadership can answer early. also noticed the studio encoder failed to init on the rehearsal. can someone from AV triage quickly?

streaming-bot: ALERT: encoder.init failed (exit_code=1). last log: "timeout waiting for /dev/video0". fallback options: Zoom RTMP or local OBS.

lee: on it. brb at the AV closet. if we can't get hardware encoder i'll spin up a VM-based restream.

toni: leader heads-up: can we keep the Dedicated pricing slide toward the top? customers in the thread asked about commitment windows. would be good to address live.

dave: I can field the Dedicated timeline Qs. save 8-10 minutes for those.

maria: quick logistics ask 0s: could we record the Q&A window as separate clip? need it for the hiring FAQ.

lee: encoder is flaky. temp fix: switch OBS to software encoder x264 and stream to rtmp://stream.redwood.dev/allhands. test cmd:
```
ffmpeg -f v4l2 -i /dev/video0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -f flv rtmp://stream.redwood.dev/allhands
```

infra-bot: Reminder: avoid heavy dataset exports during all-hands (slot: 16:40-17:10 UTC). Network QoS ensured for 30m.

sam: good catch. @leadership pls join here for the first Qs. @dave you'll take Dedicated pricing, @toni you'll cover Private rollout dates. we'll do the demo after the Qs.

dave: noted. also, heads-up for the demo: i asked eng to checkpoint the canary model onto a small instance to avoid pulling from prod. should be ready.

lee: OBS test green locally, but hardware encoder still not giving video feed. switching to laptop camera as backup. anyone who needs slides, confirm you uploaded v2 to the drive.

maria: slides v2 uploaded to Drive -> All-Hands/2024-11-15/v2. linked in calendar.

toni: can we push a 2min mic check for leadership before we go live? want to catch any audio issues.

sam: yes. schedule 2-min mic check at T-2. leaders please be in the room at T-3.

lee: RTMP endpoint warmed; credentials DM'd to ops. will start RTMP if encoder doesn't recover in 60s.

streaming-bot: recorder.health: degraded. recording fallback will be local OBS file with periodic uploads to GCS.

dave: for the Dedicated pricing Q: short note to leadership 0s: if commit tiers change, we need a clear note for sales and billing. I'll sync post-call.

sam: thanks all. final checklist before we open: leadership present? slides uploaded? RTMP ready? mic check? :eyes: 

maria: leadership in room. slides confirmed. mic test ok on my end.

lee: encoder still dead; starting RTMP fallback now. OBS recording started (path: /var/tmp/allhands_backup.mp4).

infra-bot: Canary cluster scaled to 3 nodes for demo (action: scale-up-5513).

sam: launching meeting in 1m. if anything breaks, post here and we'll pause. thanks team!
